title.en: Start with the tools you need.

introduction.en: Setup adds an agent-focused choice, while connection requests stay available long enough to answer.
introduction.fr: La configuration propose un choix dédié aux agents, et les demandes de connexion vous laissent le temps de répondre.

body.en: Choose AI agents during setup to enable them and connect their apps without turning on the terminal.
body.fr: Choisissez les agents IA pendant la configuration pour les activer et connecter leurs applications, sans activer le terminal.

notes: The setup asks how you will use Lilo with a third choice between browsing and developing: with your AI agents, which turns them on and walks you through connecting them, without the terminal.

body.en: Permission requests reveal a hidden sidebar. Agent connection requests wait ten minutes, and reconnecting while you answer keeps the prompt open.
body.fr: Les demandes d’autorisation révèlent la barre latérale masquée. Celles des agents attendent dix minutes et restent ouvertes si l’agent se reconnecte pendant votre réponse.

notes: A permission request, such as an AI agent asking to connect, slides a hidden sidebar out so it can be answered, and an agent's connection request waits ten minutes instead of two.

An AI agent that reconnects while you are on your way to answer, as Claude Desktop's local agent mode does, is no longer refused behind your back: its request stays up, and once you allow it, its next connection is let in.
